en: The postcard shows a street scene with historical European-style buildings lining both sides of the road, which appears mostly empty except for a few people visible in old-fashioned clothing in the background. In the foreground, two modern individuals walk with bicycles, suggesting a juxtaposition of old and new. There is some text at the bottom with the words 'Nijmegen' and 'van Broekhuijsenstraat.' The image has a sepia or grayscale tone, typical of old postcards.
